raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Project Manager II – GBS Transformation TEVA GBS | August 2025 – July 2026 | Bengaluru







Designed and delivered Lean Six Sigma capability programs, training 100+ employees across Yellow Belt and Green Belt certifications. Led enterprise-wide Quality Week initiatives engaging 200+ employees, promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement culture. Mentored Lean Six Sigma improvement projects GBS Finance, guiding teams through DMAIC methodology and sustainable implementation. Led the Train-the-Trainer (TTT) program by coaching Yellow Belt candidates, facilitating workshops, and building internal Continuous Improvement capability across cross-functional GBS teams. Led a Lean Six Sigma project that reduced LATAM bank open items by 75% through process standardization, SAP ECC cash application optimization, and elimination of manual Excel-based remittance workflows across five countries. Enhance three-way invoice matching by optimizing OCR accuracy for clean-match processing, increasing OCR accuracy from 76% to 90%+, improving touchless invoice processing by 20 percentage points Led a Lean Six Sigma initiative to streamline the Record-to-Report month-end close by optimizing journal entry and reconciliation workflows, reducing close cycle time from 8 to 5 business days, decreasing late journal entries by 60%.
•
•
Automated operational reporting by developing Power BI dashboards, eliminating manual reporting effort by 20+ hours per week and enabling real-time operational performance monitoring. Managed enterprise LexComply governance by coordinating with global stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance and policy adherence
Principle specialist – Lean and CI Pratt and Whitney | July 2022 – August 2025 | Bengaluru







Led the Customer-Oriented Results and Excellence (CORE) initiative for the ICC division, driving enterprise-wide continuous improvement programs. Designed and implemented the organizational Control Tower framework, aligning operational KPIs with 5-year, 3- year, and annual strategic objectives. Designed and implemented Business Maturity Assessment across P2P functions benchmarking operational capability and improving overall maturity from Level 2.8 to Level 3.9. Led a Lean Six Sigma project to improve PO first-pass accuracy from 62% to 93% by eliminating compliance rejection defects. Designed and implemented a RPA solution to automate PO creation, eliminating manual validation activities, improving PO processing efficiency and compliance, and achieving 2 FTE annual savings. Led a Lean initiative to reduce invoice exceptions by optimizing PO matching, GR/IR reconciliation, and payment block resolution, reducing blocked invoices from 28% to <12and decreasing manual processing effort by 30%. Developed interactive Power BI dashboards supporting supplier performance, quality, and on-time delivery metrics.
Lean Engineer and Continuous improvement Moog Controls India Pvt Ltd | November 2017 – July 2022 | Bengaluru





•
Responsible to drive Continuous Improvement activities like 5S, Kaizen, Gemba walk and employee suggestion scheme across the plant. Serve as a self-motivated process change agent working closely with senior leadership to execute the site level business strategy (X-matrix development & deployment). Led a cross-functional Value Stream Mapping (VSM) transformation, reduced manufacturing lead time by 11.1 to 4.5 days, WIP reduced by 59% improved FPY from 92% to 99.5%, and productivity increase from 45 to 90 units through end-to-end waste elimination. Spearheaded a Six Sigma initiative that reduced non-moving inventory by 86% through inventory aging analysis, safety stock review, and material rationalization. Improved machining OEE from 58% to 76% by implementing SMED, TPM, and 5S, reducing setup time by 43%, increasing output by 28. Facilitate VSM workshops and create lean layouts to boost SQCDM performance of the product lines. Facilitate daily tier level meetings at shop floor and nurture the problem-solving skills across the organization using A3 & 8D problem solving method. Develop Quality Clinic & Obeya room and organize regular reviews.
